lines.text: Six apps you pay for have free alternatives!
The last one is insane. Stay for it.
Calendly? Cal D I Y, for personal use.
Intercom? Chatwoot, if you host it.
VoiceStudio clones your own voice, on your own machine.
It's new, just seven months old.
We did not test these, so check each one yourself.
Save the list. Send it to a friend who pays for Loom.
The setup's in the link in bio.
Want the next one? Follow, and you'll see it.
